Dominion.TreatyDef.label: alliance
Dominion.TreatyDef.description: A full alliance: the two factions become allies, and each is expected to join any war declared on the other. Ends if either side attacks the other or the alliance is cancelled.

Dominion.TreatyDef.label: non-aggression pact
Dominion.TreatyDef.description: Both sides promise not to attack each other for 120 days. Breaking it costs reputation with every faction.

Dominion.TreatyDef.label: trade agreement
Dominion.TreatyDef.description: Preferential trade for 180 days: you buy from them 10% cheaper and sell to them 10% dearer, and both economies grow a little.

Dominion.TreatyDef.label: defensive pact
Dominion.TreatyDef.description: Each side promises to join any war declared on the other. Refusing when called breaks the pact.

Dominion.TreatyDef.label: intelligence sharing
Dominion.TreatyDef.description: For 120 days the two sides share what they learn. You gain intel on the partner, and some on its enemies. Kept secret.
